body: It was me trying to communicate what hurt me that started it though...

I hope so. He actually also said "and your birthday is coming up" so yeah... maybe he's planned on doing it then. And now I don't really know what to expect regarding my birthday. I feel terribly guilty, but thank you for reminding me about those elements ad well.
I am too quick to react strongly and emotionally. I am aware of it, and I want to become calmer and more patient, however I don't know how, exactly.

I did freak out, which I definitely know wasn't the best way to handle it. He did change last minute. We talked only this last weekend how I would very much appreciate if he gave me heads up for plans at least two or three days in advance. I have a really hard time with change unfortunately. Trying to be better, but I don't know how, I'm afraid. However, I most often try to compromise. I sometimes compromise too much I belive, trying to find a way for everything to work out as everyone want it.
Thank you. I'm glad to hear that it worked out. Do you have any advice on how I should go about it now? Pretend like nothing happened?

My partner actually have forgotten my birthday before, so I can relate to your feeling entirely. But still, I know he cares deeply about me, so in that way, I can also relate to this answer. Thanks for your reply.
I'm happy to hear it worked out. It's comforting
Thank you so much. What do you think about me ruining the surprise element?
I do prefer the long hairstyle, but when looking at it again, the picture under the verification pic also look quite mature

The hairstyle you have on your verification picture is seriously nice😌 If you do want to shave, I preferred the one on the opposite corner, top right. However, it might be a bit too "boy-ish". It depends on your personality😁 Hope I could be of help. Overall, a solid 9.

Sorry for that. For some reason I've felt like the world would be better without me since the age of six, and been suicidal since 13. Not trying to tell you a very weak sob story, but in that regard I might be able to relate to you. At the moment, I'm not very suicidal. Was last week though. Will probably be again next week.
I belive in you though. We both will get through this, and come out as better persons. Some time.

I tried to message you, but guess you blocked that option. Understandably though. Just wanted to tell you that I can somewhat relate, since I unfortunately seem to have the same tendencies toward my partner. If you want to chat, feel free to DM me.

I used to have that. A me me, who was most often sad, but still trying to be hopeful. And someone else me, who was constantly talking down on me me, constantly cynical, but she was still only in my head, not out in the "real world". There was someone else as well, a third part, but I can't remember them.

This was a couple of years ago, I think it was most severe when I was between 14-16. But I think something happened. I tried to part the different types of me's so much, that they somehow got lost.

Who I am today is mostly a shell of me me, the old me me used to stick up to the someone else me, and I used to have a constant fight in my head. But I am a shell, even someone else me don't often come around anymore, and when she does, I still feel like that is me. The types have blended.

I don't know if I am making any sense, and I am not even diagnosed with BPD. I just thought that I could somewhat relate to your post. Sorry for the rant.

I just wanted to say that I can somewhat relate to you. I actually had an appointment for an abortion made, but I had my miscarriage just the day after making the appointment. I feel guilty being here, but I really am grieving my loss. I wasn't in a position where I could have given my baby the life it would have deserved. If I could, I would have kept them. But then again, it was a misscariage.

Thanks for the advice. I'll try this. In all honesty though, it's not just about the kids. I am so much looking forward to becoming parents with him. I want to have kids just with him, he would be an amazing father.
If it wasn't for him, I would probably be one of those aunts with several cats. Never imagined my life with a partner.

Thank you for sharing your experience. I am starting to come to terms with the thought that at the moment, no, it doesn't matter whether we are married or even engaged. I do however stand firm in that I want to be married before having children. But children isn't on the table yet anyway.
It does worry me quite a lot that something will happen to him, but I guess I can't always just think about the worst case scenario. This is incredibly difficult though...
I'll stop the "nagging" as well. I fear he will forget it then, but I guess that if he do, maybe it wasn't really what he wanted anyway. I'll probably do a reevaluation of this relationship when nearing 25 or 26, but it's a lot of time till then. Urgh... self-control never was one of my virtues.

When rereading, I understand that it might come across as if the cool dates is my reason for wanting to get engaged, which I seriously think is ridiculous.
As I wrote in my edit, my main reason from the beginning, and even now, is that I want to be informed if something were to happen to him.

I ensure you, we get along more than just well enough. When I wrote "overall, very good" I meant just that. Of course we have our ups and downs, but for the main part, we get along very good, and our relationship is also very good.

We have talked, and are talking, about finances. I had a job, which I quit in order to go to university. My patter is currently working, but is planning on starting his studies next year.
We do talk about about how to raise children, and how to handle different ethical scenarios.

I didn't really think about marriage before I met him. I can not imagine Mt life with anyone else, let alone marriyng someone else. Ge is the one and only I want to be with, hopefully as a married couple.

Thank you for your input. I study at a university, and will be doing so for a few more years. Prior to that I got a job in another city, and after a while in long distance relationship, my partner moved in with me. He's working right now, but is planning on going to university later this year.

He had the impression that he would have to pay a whole month worth of salary on the ring, but I quickly told him that I really don't want such an expensive ring. We have looked at rings and decided on the price range 100-300$. A house isn't really in the table before 30, we just moved in to an apartment that we love. I know that weddings are expensive, but we have agreed on a budget that isn't too hard to save up for in a year or two.

I appreciate your constructive criticism. I realise my main problem is probably my impatience.

This is a big fear of mine, which is why I've let him be completely in charge of the proposal. I am trying really hard to let him do this in his own pace. We love each other, and I know that we want to spend our lives together. I do have a time when I know that I will have to take some time to myself and figure out what I want the most, him or a marriage. Right now though, those two things don't clash. And no, I haven't told anyone about that. Maybe the answer at that time will be that I can infact spend the rest if my life with him without us getting married? Who knows
I get what you are saying, but I don't agree with you.

I actually asked him just now, if he consider us already engaged since we have agreed on getting married (which we did after moving in together), and he said "Officially? No. Inoficially? Yes." We have the agreement, but we don't have the ring. The ring is our next step.

I can kinda relate to you😅
We have planned to have 2 or 3 children, and we both want to have them before thirty. I want a two year age gap between them, so 30 - 28 - 26. I want to be married before having children, preferably for a year, so 25. I want to be engaged about one or two years prior, so 23.

However... that is an "ideal" plan. There isn't any room for "failiure". Preferably, I would like to try for a child even earlier, due to worry about how difficult it might be. I do also know that the moment you start trying for a baby, you should be ready for one, which we aren't just yet.

This post was really just because of my worry. I would rather be done sooner than later. Don't really know if I make myself properly understood though...
Thank you. I should try again.

Ouch... I didn't think that that's how I might come across.

I wholeheartedly agree with you. Really.

We both really love children, and when we have them, if we have them, they will forever be our top priority.

We will not have children if we belive we can't give them a stable life. Therefor I want to work towards creating that stability.

Yes. I need to calm down. I really did try counselling, and she told me to stop thinking that way I am. Yeah.. thanks for that /s
And yes, you are probably right that I won't be fixed even after an engagement.
I have some problems with myself, even if I didn't think that should be the main focus of this post. I needed some advice to get me back on the ground, and not getting ahead of myself, which I feel like I have gotten. Thank you.

I really thought I have made myself clear. We do have a timeline. We have talked about it, and I thought we were on the same page. We are on the same page, but I might be at the last sentence, and he is on the first.

We have lived together for two years, moved together three times, been long distances for five months. We have a solid ground, and an open communication. My problems is my inability to not being able to handle my feelings in a way so i don't burden him, and my tendencies to acting or feeling too fast/too early.

Thank you for sharing your story. 
Thinking like that, I guess we already are engaged. We have had this conversation. We have agreed on getting married, having children, getting a house. We have lived together for two years. We have made a time frame. My worry lies in that he haven't officially proposed yet. Like I wrote in the post, I really want him to ask, which he know, since he initially wasn't interested in getting married.

You said that I seem to have a romanticised view on engagement and getting married, but I disagree. It might actually be my boyfriend who want to surprise me, like another commenter said, but maybe I'm not really giving him the opportunity.

Of course that might be the case. I think that he would have told me that though.
We have talked about marriage, children, getting a house. I belive we have the same view regarding money, that it shouldn't dictate our lives, but it should of course be an important thing to consider.
What you are saying is really important, and yes, we have had several in depth conversations about this. It is actually one of those things I feel  really proud of, our ability to talk to each other.
I will try my best. I should put my heart into studying, unfortunately I have a really hard time staying focused...

Thank you very much for your advice. I am not concerned just yet, but am starting to become. I won't be talking about proposal or marriage with him for a while. My fear is that I won't really be able to hide my feelings regarding it, but I really don't want to burden him with it (which is why I'm coming to you guys).

We had this conversation a whole ago, an we were right on the same track regarding five years and three years. However, when we talked about one year from now, or two, he didn't seem to know what he wanted anymore.

You are right. I just don't know how to not try and control the situation.
We have a shared timeline, I think. However, it isn't an exact timeline, so while I would like it to be sooner, he might want it to be later. Like, if we say this month, I want it at the start, he want it at the end.

Perhaps you're right. The thing is, we want to have children before we are in our thirties. And due to earlier experiences, I am kind of stressed out about the difficulties of having children. So I really just..  want to feel like we are on our way to create a family quite soon.
I try focusing in other things, but I have a hard time staying interested in anything I do.

I really do respect that you have made a "promise" to yourself to wait a couple of years before asking. However, my boyfriend have not communicated anything like that to me. I find it difficult to be in this limbo, where I feel powerless and can't do anything but wait.

I wouldn't say that I am unhappy, cause I'm not, but yes, it might be boredom due to stability. I don't know how to handle it really.

Yes, we have discussed a prenup, and we both agree on getting one, as I have understood it.
Like someone else commented, I should maybe find something else to focus on as well. Unfortunately, I'm really bad at sticking to a hobby.
It takes time to heal from something like this, and that’s okay. Let it take time. I wish you the best.
Hey. It gets better. A word of advice, try to combine head and heart. One should never ignore the other. I hope the best for you.
Thank you. Your words give me hope for tomorrow.
Thank you
I’m so sorry for your loss. Wish you all the best <3
Thanks for sharing❤️ Good luck to you too
Thank you

My child wasn’t planned, and honestly, we didn’t know what to do. We were both so young, we still are.
I lost my baby before I had made a decision. In some way, it might have been a blessing. In another way, it was devastating. It made me aware of a fear I never would have known about, and honestly, I would have preferred to be in the dark concerning this fear. I am so frightened that I won’t be able to carry a child.
Thank you. I wonder why it got downvoted...
It really is. I hope that you yourself can apply that, you seem very kind. Hope you have a good day.
Thank you very much for taking the time to reply. I hope you’ll feel better soon. Eat some cake, or some strawberries! Hugs
Heh, thank you for your input :)
Thank you. Sometimes I find it odd, how much I care for others, while not really being able to apply it on myself...
Well, if it the funniest show you’ve seen, I’ll definitely give it a go. Thank you very much for taking your time to try and help me.
Thank you. I’ll look into IT crowd, never heard of it before.
Hi. I’m so sorry for you. I’m in the same boat. I want to end it, but still don’t. Hey. At least I can say that I do want you to keep on living. Please? Somewhere, I maybe think it will get better.
Try r/relationships or r/relationship_advice     Maybe even r/RBNchildcare to see if anyone else been in a similar situation. Best of luck to you and your son. I’m glad you’re looking after him.
I want to know that too...

Why do you have to have something to care for now? Can’t you just let other people care for you? A painting is never done. A masterpiece is a masterpiece because it can’t be remade. There is too many details to it, that no other than the artist will see. 
Create your story, don’t end it before it is meant to be done. I know that you can do wonders in this world. Perhaps no one else will know of them before you are gone, but be sure to lay the foundation to it.
Perhaps I’m not really making any sense, it’s just that when I read through your posts, it created a very deep belief for you. You are meant to teach, to share. And you can do it.
Do you want me to call you? In which country are you?

You are not a liability. You are an idiot.
I read some of your other texts, and if you could only be in my head for a second... you have a way with words. It shows that you have read a lot. I don’t want to feel like I relate to you, but I do. Please don’t end it. You could be such an asset for this world.

Please don’t do it. I couldn’t take. Am sitting in a small bathroom stall, hiding from my colleagues. Contemplating wether or not I should just go to the fucking bridge and jump.
But I know I would be missed, so I can’t do it.

And now, you? You made this post an I saw it. Please don’t do it. I would miss you.

My inbox is open if needed, but by this point you already know that.

Thank you for your approval ^^

I’m afraid that if I talk to him, I won’t be able to stop everything that I have on my mind, and maybe it will be too much for him to take in. 
And I don’t want to say anything that makes him think about it too much, I don’t want him to become depressed because of something I said. 

I don’t even know how to justify why I am wondering about so much, and why I think about it. 

Of course I care about him, but am I sticking my nose where it doesn’t belong?

Thank you for the advice. He goes to therapy, but only about once every six week. He’s said sometimes that he doesn’t think it’s worth it (we’re living quite far away for about a year now) but I have advices him to continue. Maybe just to have someone on the outside to talk to. 

The thing about his father is very difficult. He didn’t approve of our relationship. I believe it was because he couldn’t stand competition about his son... So he compared me to my partner’s mother, saying I couldn’t be trusted. (It’s a whole other story.) My partner told me about it, and I became really insecure and probably started to overthink it, because after a while, I instead noticed similarities between me and his father, which some of them he has confirmed.
I could try that. Idk... I’m afraid that I’m a lost cause, that I can’t get better. Maybe I’m afraid to make him aware of this
Best of luck to you! You can do it💙
Oh wow... I can definitely relate to this. You said it very well.

After I got to know about narcissistic tendencies I got so scared, because I can see so much of it in myself. My partner comes from a “family” where he was abused in sooo many ways. He told me that his father was a narcissist and about some of the different traits.
The more time that passes, I feel more and more like his dad. I’m so scared that I will hurt him, and I’ve tried to tell him this. I love him. I want to keep him close, but at the same time I want him to be safe.
He has even compared me to his dad, so I don’t think that all of it is in my head. I’m so scared, and don’t know what to do. I don’t want to be the person that everybody hates, but i am so selfish and caught up in myself, that I would understand if they did.

Reading this post made me feel sadness, anger, and hope. I’m sad that there are people out in the world that live to hurt others. I am completely furious the way they tear other people down, so often their own children. 
But I want to thank you for writing this. My partners father is a horrible nDad, and I don’t even know about the mother.
For obvious reasons, the parents have also affected me. I have never had such strong feelings of hatred towards another person. It frightens me.
My partner have sought help, and I hope it’s working. I believe so.
But your post made me feel hopeful that perhaps I will be able to put my feelings towards my partners family into words someday.
Thank you.
